latest_release.name: Apache Ozone 2.2.2
latest_release.body:
Apache Ozone 2.2.2 is a maintenance release in the 2.2 series with bug fixes and dependency updates.

Apache Ozone is a scalable, distributed object store for Hadoop and cloud-native environments.

- [Source and Linux x86_64 binary downloads, signatures, and SHA-512 checksums](https://downloads.apache.org/ozone/2.2.2/)
- [Release notes](https://ozone.apache.org/release-notes/2.2.2/)
- [Documentation](https://ozone.apache.org/docs/)
- [Apache release signing keys](https://downloads.apache.org/ozone/KEYS)

Fixes include FSO file rename handling, container upgrade compatibility, SCM delete log handling, repair-tool compatibility with RocksDB OPTIONS files, and OM request validation. Dependencies include Jackson 2.21.7 and Netty 4.1.139.

The release was built on Rocky Linux 9 for x86_64. The packaged RocksDB tools native library was verified to load and to meet the Rocky Linux 9 GLIBC and GLIBCXX compatibility baseline.

Release commit: `01e1be11f064b770dec1c0452f3e669e1125563f`.

Thanks to everyone who contributed, reviewed, and tested this release.
